column1: # Arabic pack (ar) nouns read with a number (2026-10-22).
# ar_noun: a counted noun as written in the singular -> gender|singular|dual|plural|accusative singular.
#   After 2 the dual alone is read (ساعتين), after 3-10 the plural (ثلاث ساعات), after 11-99 the
#   accusative singular (أحد عشر شهرا), after 100, 1000 … the singular (مئة ريال).
# ar_unit: a unit symbol -> the ar_noun key it reads as.
# ar_currency: a currency sign or abbreviation -> the noun key|the minor unit noun key|minor digits.
# ar_gender: the gender of a written plural or other form that is no singular key (مدارس f).
